description_en: The request boy for creating the agent
name: CreateAgent

fields.help_en:
The name of the agent.\
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (). The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length. The name is case-sensitive and encoded in UTF-8. The name cannot start with a hyphen (-) or an underscore (). You must specify a name
fields.help_zh:
代理名称。  
取值：英文小写字母、数字和特殊字符-和_，最短 3 字符， 最长 63 个字符，区分大小写，utf8 编码并且不可以- 和_开头，不能为空
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The deployment mode of the agent.\
Set the value to default, which specifies the independent process mode
fields.help_zh:
代理的部署方式。  
取值：default，独立进程方式
fields.name: deploy_method

fields.help_en:
The method that is used to access the agent.\
Valid values: public and vpc
fields.help_zh:
代理访问方式。  
取值：public，公网；vpc，专线
fields.name: agent_endpoint

fields.help_en:
The tags in the key:value format.\
The value can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and commas (,). The value can be up to 1,024 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
标签，KeyValue格式。  
允许字符：英文大小写字母、数字和特殊字符-_,。长度限制：1KB
fields.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The details for creating the agent
parameters.name: import_agent

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for creating the agent
v1_body_parameters.name: body
